description: Source code implementing a RAN resource management module for a 5G/NR network, including classes and functions for UE resource updating, cell resource allocation/deallocation, and configuration management.

classes.name: du_ran_resource_manager_impl
classes.description: Main class managing RAN resources, including UE and cell resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration updates.

classes.name: du_ue_ran_resource_updater_impl
classes.description: Helper class for updating UE RAN resources, including configuration application and deallocation.

classes.name: ue_resource_context
classes.description: Structure holding per-UE resource context, including capability management and cell configurations.

methods.name: create_ue_resource_configurator
methods.description: Creates and initializes a UE resource configurator, allocating necessary resources.

methods.name: update_context
methods.description: Updates the UE context with new configuration, handling resource deallocation and allocation as needed.

methods.name: deallocate_context
methods.description: Deallocates all resources associated with a UE.

methods.name: allocate_cell_resources
methods.description: Allocates resources for a specific cell (PCell or SCell) for a UE.

methods.name: deallocate_cell_resources
methods.description: Deallocates resources for a specific cell of a UE.

methods.name: ue_config_applied
methods.description: Marks that UE configuration has been applied, allowing cleanup of temporary resources.
